thread:
ops-bot: Heads up — we're scheduling a targeted routing reconciliation and graceful restart for the serving edge in us-west1. Window: 2026-03-10 22:00 -> 2026-03-10 23:30 UTC. Expected impact: short (under 2min) TCP reconnects for some long-lived streams while routing table convergence happens. No API key rotation; tokens and data storage unaffected. Will run in rolling batches across AZs. :mega:

maria: Thanks. Is this to apply the new prefix aggregation change from last sprint? Any chance customers will see 5xx spikes?

ops-bot: Yes, this is the prefix aggregation reconciliation to reduce duplicate routing entries. We don't expect sustained 5xx. There may be transient 503s for in-flight requests during connection handoff. We'll keep health-check thresholds aggressive to avoid flapping.

devon: Assigning oncall: @jamie-oncall — can you take ownership of post-run validation and status updates? Also please prepare the incident template and any customer-facing blurb.

jamie-oncall: On it. I'll put the incident stub in place before start. What's the customers-to-notify list? I suggest notifying Dedicated customers and any with private VPCs in us-west1.

maria: Agreed. Also ping any customers with active long-poll subscriptions — they'll want a heads-up. I'll draft the status page copy.

lisa-support: For support: please share expected start/end and who to escalate to. I'll prep canned replies.

jamie-oncall: Draft incident thread created: INC-2026-175 (internal). Creating status-page draft now.

sre-bot: Automated checklist triggered: 
1) Pre-checks: node health, KV sync ok.
2) Backup: routing config snapshot saved to s3://redwood-config-backups/2026-03-10/1950001111.json
3) Canary: run on 2 nodes in us-west1-a

ops-bot: Operation plan (high level):
- 22:00 UTC: start maintenance at small scale (canary)
- 22:15: evaluate metrics (5xx rate, reconnects, latency)
- 22:30-23:15: roll across remaining AZs in staggered batches
- 23:15-23:30: post-run validation and customer comms

jamie-oncall: Status page draft (please review): 
```
Subscribe to incidents: https://status.redwood.ai
Component: Serving edge (us-west1)
Window: 2026-03-10 22:00-23:30 UTC
Impact: Brief, intermittent reconnects for active streams. No data loss.
If you experience persistent errors after 2 minutes, open a support ticket or DM @lisa-support.
```

maria: Slight edit: add note that dedicated customers may see minor throttling during roll; include contact path for Dedicated rep.

jamie-oncall: Updated. Will also post an advance customer email 1 hour before start for Dedicated/Private customers. Template: 
"We're performing a routing reconciliation in us-west1 to improve request routing. You may see short reconnects — impacts should be transient. If you rely on persistent streams, consider retry/backoff config. Contact your rep or support if you need a maintenance exception."

devon: Can we automate the status-page update? Use the status API: 
```
curl -X POST https://status-api.redwood.ai/v1/incidents -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_TOKEN' -d '{"component":"serving-edge-us-west1","start":"2026-03-10T22:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-10T23:30:00Z","impact":"informational","body":"Planned routing reconciliation — brief reconnects possible."}'
```

jamie-oncall: I'll run that 60 minutes prior and again at T-5m with "maintenance starting" update.

ops-bot: Pre-maint checkpoints looked good. Canary started at 22:00 UTC. Monitoring dashboards: serving/latency-usw, serving/5xx-rate-usw, connections/active-streams-usw.

sre-bot: Canary note: 22:06 UTC — observed 1.2% reconnects on canary nodes, 503 spike of 0.3% lasting 12s. No escalation.

jamie-oncall: Rolling to AZs. Will post intermittent updates.

jamie-oncall: Update 22:38 UTC — roll complete across AZs. Minor reconnects during each batch, peaked at ~1.8% but returned to baseline within 90s each time. No customer reports so far.

maria: Posted public status update: "Maintenance completed in us-west1; transient reconnects observed, all systems stable."

lisa-support: Sent notification email to Dedicated customers at 23:20 UTC. Template included mitigation tips and support links.

ops-bot: Post-run validation passed. Health-checks green, KV sync stable, latency within SLA targets.

jamie-oncall: Closing internal incident INC-2026-175. Will attach runbook notes and a short postmortem summary to the incident for records.

maria: Quick learnings: add a short preflight that emails active long-poll owners 2 hours before maintenance. Also update SDK docs with recommended retry guidelines for persistent connections.

devon: Thanks team. Nice smooth run. :thumbsup:
